per_object_cap.stated: 'Sandboxes come in three sizes ... Small (2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM) at $0.0162/hour, Medium (4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM) at $0.0324/hour, and Large (8 vCPU, 16 GB RAM) at $0.0648/hour.' During the trial the sandbox limit is 5.
per_object_cap.notes: 'They use the same CPU, memory and storage rates as other resources and count toward the $19 of included usage.'

interface_detail: REST API and CLI; sandbox create takes a millisecond lifetime
tooling: lizard CLI, SDK, REST; templates include codex, claude, opencode, pi, desktop
chaining: 2 TB of included egress per account makes it the natural host for a crawler that serves what it collects
limits_note: At USD 0.0324 an hour a Medium sandbox costs USD 23.65 for a month, which is more than the USD 19 credit, so the plan cannot hold a Medium up for 730 hours either.
reliability_note: When the credit is spent, running apps, databases and Sandboxes pause and no new ones can be created; the data is kept but the service stops.

free_tier.stated: 'Pro costs $19 a month and includes $19 in monthly credits for the whole platform.' The only free path is a trial: 'Pro starts with a 7-day trial and $5 in trial credits. You need a card to start it, but we charge nothing during the 7 days.'
free_tier.notes: A plan credit equal to the plan fee, and a card-gated trial. There is no grant.

retention.stated: A successful pause stops compute charges; Persistent Volumes storage continues to be billed while data is kept.

egress.terms: Sandbox egress has no separate per-GB charge, with '2 TB per account over a rolling 30 days' included; apps and databases pay the per-GB rate.
egress.free_allowance: 2 TB over a rolling 30 days for sandboxes
